searchText: Hey all, I am working on making the tree structure and tests for trees in nim for Nimbus, by taking references from https://github.com/gballet/go-verkle/blob/master/tree_test.go and https://github.com/gballet/go-verkle/blob/master/tree.go. Can someone suggest some resources to better understand these or any suggestions about how to go about writing tests from the start? not sure it qualifies as "these days", but as far as I remember from some presentation mid last year from Peter (geth), I think he said was around 20GiB/y of only useful data (i.e: only leaves) if you account the trie structure too, it was more ~double of that. [maybe obvious clarif: ignoring blocks, receipts, etc since that's irrelevant for the migration] highly recommended: https://blog.ethereum.org/2021/12/02/verkle-tree-structure
